dct_description_sm:
This is designed to provide the public with information regarding inspections of all geographically fixed child care centre premises in Waterloo Region. Please be advised that the results of all inspections posted here describe what the Public Health Inspector (PHI) observed on the date of inspection. This data is not intended to guarantee the conditions of a child care centre premise at all times and should not be relied upon for that purpose.

No endorsement of any child care centres premise, or the products or services offered by a child care centre premise, is expressed or implied by any information, material or content included in this data.
